dct_description_sm:
Mapping depicts Brampton Plan-Schedule 1A Urban Growth Centres based on Provincial "Places to Grow" policies.

The Downtown Brampton Urban Growth Centre is a major mixed-use destination planned to accommodate significant population and employment growth through compact, transit-supportive development. As the historic and civic heart of the city, it serves as a focal point for business, culture, education, government services, and community activity.

This data is intended to be used in conjuction with other related mapping layers for this schedule, and may be impacted by other schedules, with consideration to the text of Brampton Plan.
